description: This Java class 'ContentManagementEvents' contains static methods for handling content management operations such as updating static values, creating static values, and updating publish links within the OFBiz framework. It interacts with various OFBiz components like delegator, dispatcher, and entity query, and manages content associations and links between content and websites.

classes.name: ContentManagementEvents
classes.description: A class providing static methods for content management operations such as updating static values and links within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: updateStaticValues
methods.description: Updates static content values and associations based on request parameters, managing content associations like SUBSITE.

methods.name: createStaticValue
methods.description: Placeholder method returning success; intended for creating static content values.

methods.name: updatePublishLinks
methods.description: Updates publish links between content and websites, managing content associations like PUBLISH_LINK, including enabling/disabling links and updating content status.
